name: ui-press-inset
title: Inner Press
description: Bấm nút, mặt nút chỉ hạ 1 px nhưng bóng đổ bên trong hiện lên như bị ấn lõm, viền sáng trên tắt đi; thả ra thì trở lại phẳng.

moworks.author: moworks

options.inset: px of inner shadow when pressed (32)
options.cursor: an optional cursor that makes the clicks
options.approach: [x, y] px the cursor comes from
options.lead: s it arrives before a click

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Accent button 140x46 r14. Press at 0.7 s: k 0 → 1 in 120 ms power2.out; release at 1.6 s: back in 250 ms power2.out. translateY = 1 px × k; the face darkens 12 % × k; an inner shadow of 8 soft rings from the top edge (0 → 8 px); the top light line (40 %) fades out and a light bottom line (30 %) fades in; no scale. Params: down (0.12 s) · up (0.25 s) · inset (8 px) · y (1 px) · ease (power2.out).
